question: Which of the following states is NOT a part of the Tapi Basin?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Rajasthan**__. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Tapi Basin:-**

 
 
• It​ is a river basin located in** western India.**
 
• It includes parts of **Gujarat, Maharashtra, and Madhya Pradesh.**
 
• **Rajasthan** does not fall under the Tapi Basin as it is located to the** north of the basin**.
 
• The Tapi River is the **main river** in this basin, and it flows through **Surat **and empties into the **Arabian Sea.**
 
• The Tapi Basin is known for its** fertile agricultural lands** and is an important source of water for** irrigation.**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Basins of Maharashtra:-**

 
 
• Godavari Basin**​**
 
• Tapi Basin
 
• Krishna Basin
 
• Penganga Basin
 
• Wardha Basin
 
• Wainganga Basin
 
 
 
• Basins of **Madhya Pradesh:-**
 
 
• **​**Narmada Basin
 
• Chambal Basin
 
• Betwa Basin
 
• Ken Basin
 
• Son Basin
 
 
 
• Basins of **Gujarat:-**
 
 
• Narmada Basin
 
• Mahi Basin
 
• Sabarmati Basin
 
• Luni Basin
 
• ​It is also the state with the** largest share **of the Tapi Basin.
